title: Vault Policy Compiler
description: Compiles HashiCorp Vault policies and auth role bindings. Enforces: policy file parses, all paths within allowed prefix list, capabilities from allowed set, no wildcard paths without exception, all bound roles/service accounts exist.

error_codes.VP001: vault-policy-spec.json missing or invalid — required: name, paths[], roles[]
error_codes.VP002: Vault path is outside allowed prefix list
error_codes.VP003: Wildcard path used without explicit exception
error_codes.VP004: Capability not in allowed set: create, read, update, delete, list, patch
error_codes.VP005: Policy grants broader access than least-privilege rule requires
error_codes.VP006: Bound role or service account not declared in spec
